definitions.explanation: Describes a situation where one entity controls something exclusively, shutting out others. Often used in business and economic contexts.

examples.japanese: {独占的|どくせんてき}な⟦{地位|ちい}→地位：03427_chii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{築|きず}く→築く：02046_kizuku⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{独占的|どくせんてき}な⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: That company holds monopolistic power in the market.

examples.japanese: {独占的|どくせんてき}な⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Monopolistic trading practices are regulated by law.

notes:
USAGE:
{独占的|どくせんてき} is formed from ⟦{独占|どくせん}→独占：13494_dokusen⟧ (monopoly) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (adjective-forming suffix). It is commonly used in economic, legal, and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {独占的|どくせんてき}⟦{地位|ちい}→地位：03427_chii⟧ (monopolistic position)
- {独占的|どくせんてき}な⟦{支配|しはい}→支配：01421_shihai⟧ (exclusive control)
- {独占的|どくせんてき}な⟦{権利|けんり}→権利：02711_kenri⟧ (exclusive rights)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{排他的|はいたてき}→排他的：06388_haitateki⟧ (exclusive, exclusionary) focuses on shutting others out, while {独占的|どくせんてき} focuses on one party having sole control. {寡占的|かせんてき} describes an oligopoly where a few entities share dominance.
